book.name: Joŋ
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Joŋ gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso le nchɛnɛ shóŋ wù joŋe

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, muh wù leese a kitaŋ ki shóŋ le, wu baaŋ lee gɛ nyu fɛ jwe wu kitaŋ le gɛ, wu bɛɛŋ lo yi kitaŋ le fɛ wu lee, tu wuwɛɛ muh le choŋ, nyu muh wù lode mwɛɛ bɛ bvuŋga.
Geenɛ muh wù chiɛɛne shóŋ to wu leese fie nyu fɛ jwe wu kitaŋ le.
Wuwɛɛ muh le muh, wù muh wù chiɛɛne jwe wu kitaŋ to wu gwenyɛ jwe wu kitaŋ, wu lee wu tɛɛŋ shóŋ ye a jee le, yi yu jɛ ye, wu mo wu jo wu bu bɛ yi akfuuŋ.
Sege wu bvusɛ shóŋ ye yichii akfuuŋ, wu mo wu gɛɛne fwe wu tɛŋe shóŋ yiyu yi bii wu le, nje yi kee jɛ ye.
Nɛ le muh wu nchɛ, yi gɛ bi wu le gɛ. Yi tu yi lege lo wu, nje gɛ yi kee jɛ yi muh wu nchɛ gɛ.”

content: No Jiso ma ŋgaŋ wunɛ bo le noo, bo gɛ kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme bo le a ŋgaŋ wɛɛ le gɛ.
Noo, Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ le mɛ wù le jwe wu kitaŋ fɛ shóŋ fede fo.
Bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ sa mɛ fwe gɛ̀ bee bachoŋ mo bamii ba lode mwɛɛ a bvuŋga le. Noo shóŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ yu gɛ fiɛɛ fì bo gɛ̀ jɛme gɛ.
Le mɛ wù le jwe wu kitaŋ. Muh fe yi ye yaŋ le fɛ wu lee, tu wu lé wu gê wu bônɛ. Wu lé wu gê wu nyû njɛ shoŋ yì bude yi gɛɛne yi jii mwɛɛ yi kaase yi tuu jiŋ a kitaŋ le.
Choŋ to wu too gɛh ki wu chôŋ lo, bɛ ki wu yû lo, mo ki wu chɛ̂ŋe lo bɛ fiɛɛ. Nto fiaŋ lɛ bamii kɛmɛ nyu kinche, kinche ki yisɛ chuule.
Le mɛ wù le nchiɛnɛ shóŋ wù joŋe. Nchiɛnɛ shóŋ wù joŋe nyaa kinche ke ki wu kwê nje shóŋ ye.
Muh wù ba jo gɛh lo wu lɛme le, njɛ le muh wù chiɛɛne shóŋ sɛŋ, gɛ shóŋ nyu ye gɛ, wu yɛŋ kfuula too, wu mo wu noŋ shóŋ wu fɛɛ lo, kfuula mo wu shɛɛ wu kooyɛ shóŋ yimi, yimi saaŋɛ.
Wu to wu lege nje ba jo lo wu lɛme le, wu kwe gɛ fiɛɛ fɛ shóŋ chiɛɛ le gɛ.
Le mɛ wù le nchiɛnɛ shóŋ wù joŋe. Ŋkee shóŋ yì le yaŋ, shóŋ yaŋ kee tɛ mɛ,
gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no Chii kee mɛ, ŋkee tɛ Chii, nle nnya kinche kaŋ ki ŋkwe nje shóŋ yaŋ.
Ŋkɛme tɛ shóŋ yimi yì le gɛ ŋgoo yinɛ le gɛ. Ŋkɛme ki nto bɛ yi tɛ yi yûge jɛ yaŋ, ŋgoo yaŋ yi shóŋ mo yi nyu yimimia nchiɛnɛ shóŋ le wu mumwaa.
Nle nnya kinche kaŋ ki ŋkwe wu lɛ taŋlo ŋkaasɛ nfi kinche kaŋ jiŋ. Nɛ fiɛɛ fì Chii koŋe mɛ yu.
Gɛ muh nyu yu wu fii kinche kaŋ gɛ. Nyaa mɛ kinche kaŋ a koŋ waŋ le. Ŋkɛme bvuŋga ki nnya kinche kaŋ ki ŋkwe, ŋkɛme bvuŋga ki ŋkaasɛ nfi kinche kaŋ jiŋ. Finɛ fiɛɛ le fì jɛmɛ Chii lɛ ŋgê.”

content: No Jiso jɛmɛ mwɛɛ munɛ nɛ, kiŋgaye ka ki to antɛnɛɛ a Bajuu.
Bamii ba duude bo tu bo duu lɛ, “Wu kɛme nchɛndaa wu debele, wu jede lo. Bɛŋ yege nyu la a wu le?”
Geenɛ bamu tu bo duu lɛ, “Gɛ banɛ bajɛme nyu ba muh wù kɛme banchɛndaa ba debele gɛ. Taŋlo nchɛndaa wu debele gwenyɛ ajii a kinfeeŋ?”
Jiso dunyɛ lɛ wu le Mwa Nyo
Gɛ̀ bee kife ki Ŋka wumu ki ba kwajɛ no ba gɛ̀ kaasɛ ba gwenyɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ Yɛlusalɛm,
Jiso gɛɛŋ wu jiɛnyi fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le, fɛ ŋgaa wu Salamoŋ le. Sege kɛɛ gɛ̀ bee kife ki nfii.
Bajuu ja bo to bo tuŋ kiŋgaŋ bo tasɛ, bo biih wu le lɛ, “Wo lé wo gê wo chînɛ bee be mɛ̂ gɛh be ŋgɛ̂ɛme nɛ gɛ̂ɛŋ bû nɛɛ? Nɛ wo le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka, wo sɛɛŋ bee le chaaŋ.”

content.text: “Nle nsɛɛŋ wa bɛŋ le, bɛŋ baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ. Chilɛme chi ŋgee a jee chi Chii le, chi duunyi muh wu le mɛ.
Geenɛ bɛŋ baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ, nje gɛ bɛŋ nyu ŋgoo yi shóŋ yaŋ le gɛ.
Shóŋ yaŋ to yi yuge jɛ yaŋ. Ŋkee yi, yi bii mɛne,
nyaa kinche kì kage gɛ yi le. Gɛ yi nyu yi to yi lɛsɛ gɛ. Gɛ muh nyu yu wu yu wu lo yi chiaaŋ yaŋ le gɛ.
Chii wu le wu nya shóŋ yi yu mɛne fede muh wuchii, gɛ muh nyu yu wù taŋlo wu lo yi chiaaŋ ye le gɛ.
Besa Chii le fiɛɛ le fimimia.”

content: Bajuu ka bo jo ata ki bo tumɛ wu yu.

content.text: “Bɛŋ le bɛŋ yɛŋ wa chilɛme chì joŋe le wesee chì Chii jɛme lɛ ŋgêe. Le chi la, chi bɛŋ goone ki bɛŋ tûmɛ mɛ nje chi?”

content: Bo chvuu wu le lɛ, “Gɛ bee tume wo nyu nje lɛme chì joŋe chì wo ge gɛ. Bee tume wo nyu nje wo chɛŋe bɛ jee chi Nyo. Wo le gɛh lo muh wu wuŋ, wo duu lɛ wo le Nyo.”

content.text: “Gɛ fi nyu ba saŋ a Ŋwa wene wu banchi le lɛ Nyo jɛme yo lɛ, ‘Nle njɛmɛ lɛ bɛŋ le banyo?’
Nyo tɛŋe bamii bayu lɛ banyo, nyu gɛh bo bayu ba jɛ ye gɛ̀ gɛnɛ fɛ bo le, besabɛŋ kee lɛ gɛ fiɛɛ fì le a Ŋwa wu Nyo le taŋlo fi kusɛ gɛ.
No fi le noo, le nje la fì bɛŋ jɛme muh wù Chii cha wu tuŋ yi woŋ kfunɛ le lɛ wu chɛŋe bɛ jee chi Nyo, gɛ nje wu le wu jɛmɛ lɛ wu le Mwa Nyo?
Nle njɛ ŋgee nyu chilɛme chì Chii lɛ sɛŋ, keefɛ bɛŋ bɛ̂ɛŋ mɛne gɛ.
Geenɛ le lɛ ŋgee nyu chi, bɛŋ baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ mo mɛne gɛ, bɛŋ bɛɛŋ chi le, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ kee chuule lɛ Chii le yi ye yaŋ le, mɛ nyu ye yi Chii le.”

content: Bajuu ka bo goone ki bo koo wu, geenɛ wu tɛɛshɛ chiaaŋ yiboo le.
Jiso ka wu gɛɛŋ wu daŋ Joo yì Jodaŋ kiwuŋ kì Joŋ gɛ̀ kɛ wu leese bamii yo a joo, wu tu wù nyu yo.
Bamii ba duude tu bo too bo yɛde wu le. Bo gɛ̀ ja bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Joŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ ge gɛ fiɛɛ fimi fì duunyi bvukugɛ bvu Nyo gɛ. Geenɛ fiɛɛ fichii fì wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ kune muh wunɛ gɛ̀ bee fì nchiɛɛŋ.”
Noo bamii ba duude leesɛ muntele yi Jiso le yo.

footnotes.text: Ŋka wunɛ gɛ̀ bee ki ba kwajɛ no ba gɛ̀ kfuŋ yeh yi kintanyɛ nje muh mu wù gɛh bee gɛ muh wu Bajuu gɛ, gɛ̀ sɛɛ finyuŋa yu.
